mule.xsi:schemaLocation: http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core/current/mule.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core/current/mule-ee.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http/current/mule-http.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit/current/mule-apikit.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os/current/mule-os.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db/current/mule-db.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email/current/mule-email.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/vm http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/vm/current/mule-vm.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/secure-properties http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/secure-properties/current/mule-secure-properties.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/api-gateway http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/api-gateway/current/mule-api-gateway.xsd

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import modules::Masking output application/json var e = vars.envelope.event --- { "type": "ALERT", eventId: e.eventId, transactionId: e.transaction.transactionId, eventTimestamp: e.eventTimestamp, amount: e.transaction.amount, currency: e.transaction.currency, maskedCard: Masking::maskCard(e.card.maskedCardNumber), cardToken: e.card.cardToken, cardType: e.card.cardType, customerId: e.customer.customerId, customerName: e.customer.name, merchantName: e.merchant.merchantName, merchantCountry: e.merchant.merchantCountry, riskScore: vars.final.riskScore, riskBand: vars.final.riskBand, decision: vars.final.decision, ruleHits: vars.final.ruleHits, correlationId: vars.corrId }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'ALERT_PIPELINE_ERROR type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ' corrId=' ++ (vars.corrId default 'n/a') ++ ' desc=' ++ (error.description default '')]

set-variable.doc:name: Decide action
set-variable.value: #[if (vars.entry != null and vars.entry.windowEnd > (now() as Number)) 'SUPPRESS' else if (vars.entry != null and sizeOf(vars.entry.suppressed default []) > 0) 'AGGREGATE' else 'IMMEDIATE']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { eventId: vars.alert.eventId, transactionId: vars.alert.transactionId, eventTimestamp: vars.alert.eventTimestamp, amount: vars.alert.amount, currency: vars.alert.currency, merchantName: vars.alert.merchantName, riskScore: vars.alert.riskScore, ruleCodes: vars.alert.ruleHits.ruleCode }

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'ALERT_DECISION action=' ++ vars.alertAction ++ ' eventId=' ++ vars.alert.eventId ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]

os:store.doc:name: Append suppressed txn
os:store.os:value: #[{ windowEnd: vars.entry.windowEnd, maskedCard: vars.alert.maskedCard, suppressed: ((vars.entry.suppressed default []) ++ [vars.summary]) }]

os:store.doc:name: Open window
os:store.os:value: #[{ windowEnd: (now() as Number) + (p('alert.throttle.windowSeconds') as Number), maskedCard: vars.alert.maskedCard, suppressed: [] }]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'ALERT_EMAIL_FAILED eventId=' ++ vars.alert.eventId ++ ' status=PENDING type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]
#[output text/plain --- 'AGGREGATE_EMAIL_FAILED card=' ++ vars.aggMasked ++ ' will retry on next flush type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier]

db:bulk-update.doc:name: Update alert_status
db:bulk-update.db:sql: UPDATE fraud_events SET alert_status = :status WHERE event_id = :eventId

when.expression: #[vars.entry != null and vars.entry.windowEnd <= (now() as Number) and sizeOf(vars.entry.suppressed default []) > 0]

db:select.doc:name: Pending alerts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT event_id, transaction_id, event_timestamp, customer_id, card_token, masked_card, amount, currency, merchant_id, merchant_country, risk_score, risk_band, decision, correlation_id FROM fraud_events WHERE alert_status = 'PENDING' AND created_at < (NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50
SELECT rule_code, rule_name, rule_weight FROM fraud_rule_hits WHERE event_id = :id

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "type": "ALERT", eventId: vars.row.event_id, transactionId: vars.row.transaction_id, eventTimestamp: vars.row.event_timestamp as String, amount: vars.row.amount, currency: vars.row.currency, maskedCard: vars.row.masked_card, cardToken: vars.row.card_token, customerId: vars.row.customer_id, merchantName: vars.row.merchant_id, merchantCountry: vars.row.merchant_country, riskScore: vars.row.risk_score, riskBand: vars.row.risk_band, decision: vars.row.decision, ruleHits: vars.hitRows map (h) -> { ruleCode: h.rule_code, ruleName: h.rule_name, ruleWeight: h.rule_weight }, correlationId: vars.row.correlation_id }

db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fraud_events WHERE risk_band = 'HIGH' AND created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL ${monitor.spikeWindowMinutes} MINUTE)

when.expression: #[(vars.spikeRows[0].cnt as Number) > (p('monitor.highSpikeThreshold') as Number) and not vars.cooling]

email:send.subject: #['[MONITOR] Spike in HIGH-risk payments: ' ++ vars.spikeRows[0].cnt ++ ' in last ${monitor.spikeWindowMinutes} min']

email:body.email:content: Possible coordinated attack. Check the fraud review console.
